name: workflow-tools
description: Codex planning, independent counsel, explanations, sidebar recovery, toolbox synchronization, and explicit shipping skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, explain, recover sidebars, sync, and ship.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Tools packages ChatGPT Planner for global GPT-6 Pro consultation with one conversation per Codex task in Plan Mode, OS default browser selection and live connection checks before new requests, browser creation and native messaging when available, Claude Counselor for bounded independent planning and code review, Explain Clearly for concise explanations, Deep Planning for adversarial critique, Recover Codex Sidebar for on-request macOS project mapping recovery after account switches, SSH connection changes, and selected layout imports, Sync Toolbox for applying the published toolbox and checking installed plugin, MCP, and skill health with actionable diagnostics, and Ship Toolbox for explicit validation, commit, push, CI, and local marketplace refresh workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $recover-codex-sidebar to restore missing macOS sidebar projects after an account or SSH connection change, or import a selected existing layout.
Use $chatgpt-planner to consult GPT-6 Pro with global setup and one conversation per Plan-mode task.
Use $explain-clearly to answer directly, adapt the depth to my question, and add examples or visuals only when they help.
Use $deep-planning to critique this plan before implementation.
Use $claude-counselor for bounded independent planning and final code review on major work.
Use $ship-toolbox to validate, commit, push, refresh, and verify the current toolbox changes.
Use $sync-toolbox to update this machine from published main and verify the full managed setup.
Use $sync-toolbox in health-only mode to check installed plugins, MCP servers, and skills without updates or repairs.
Review this Plan Mode request for assumptions, risks, and routing.
